Check out Psychopomp Gold HERE!

notes.title: Psychopomp Patch Notes for March 18th, 2024
notes.content:
This is a tiny patch with a couple maintenance changes.

Changes:

Fixed a few places where the translation wasn't recognized, and would not appear
You can now use healing items by dragging them onto your face
Updated Credits to include Supporters


Thanks for playing Psychopomp! I hope you'll continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: Psychopomp Patch Notes for March 13th, 2024
notes.content:
This is a small patch to fix a few things.

Fixes:

Various fixes to Russian Translation
Fixes to Portuguese translation on one of the findable pages
Moved interaction symbol close to mouse cursor to make more apparent that they are connected (many players were attempting to use the "finger" symbol as a cursor rather than the pointer)
Added outline to mouse cursor to make it stand out more.


I hope you're enjoying Psychopomp! As always, if you run into any bugs or problems, feel free to reach out to me.

Thanks,
-Karbonic

notes.title: Psychopomp is now available in Portuguese!
notes.content:
I would have never expected to be here so soon after the last update, but in lightning speed,
Uneven Prankster and Sarqueen have translated all of Psychopomp into Portuguese!
I am truly thankful for this, and I hope you will all enjoy it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830893/50f7d9eeba61d8b8e7ad0a627faff46902edbd5b.png

Other Changes:

Fixed certain dialogues that would not appear translated
Fixed certain dialogues spilling outside of their respective textboxes
Fixed Audio Error where a Thrait woman would speak from hundreds of feet away
Fixed problem where "Real World Tip" would not appear
Added barrier to stop player from crawling through a furnace and outside of the world


As always, thank you so much for playing Psychopomp!
I appreciate all of the support!
If you find any bugs or errors, please let me know right away!

Have a good one!
-Karbonic

notes.title: Psychopomp Patch Notes for February 20th, 2024
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I've worked hard on this patch/update, so I hope you'll enjoy what's inside!

New Stuff:

New Epilogue Added
New interactions added for objects throughout the world
Signs added to make it more clear when safeguards are turned off in the School Level


Fixes:

Fixed various spelling mistakes
Fixed a few collision detection errors


I hope you'll have a good time with this update! As always, feel free to give me feedback and suggestions on what you'd like to see in Psychopomp!

Thanks!
-Karbonic

notes.title: Psychopomp Patch Notes for February 11th, 2024
notes.content:
Here's a patch that fixes some long standing bugs, and some new ones created by last patch

New:

Forbidden Location

Fixes:

Fixed an interaction between the free camera system and the elevators which would break the elevator cutscene
Fixed bug where some NPCs would not be able to talk if another had been killed in front of them
Fixed bug where progress in the Hospital would not reset upon death
Fixed bug where inventory would not reset on a new game, leading to overflow and softlocks
Fixed problem where NPCs would speak out of another person's mouth


I hope you'll continue to enjoy Psychopomp! As always, thanks for playing!

-Karbonic

notes.title: Psychopomp Patch Notes for February 4th, 2024
notes.content:
Here's a small patch to bring a handful of QoL changes to Psychopomp.

Changes:


The player can now hold Ctrl to look around freely, allowing to see different angles of areas
Interaction Modes can now be selected with number keys
Ending Cutscene Text no longer goes by too fast
Health Syringes now heal for 3 points of HP rather than 2
Small lights have been added to the floor in some areas of the Factory
Fixed area where player could softlock themselves in the Factory


Thanks for playing Psychopomp! I hope you will enjoy this update, and stick around for more in the future!

Thanks!
-Karbonic

notes.title: Psychopomp Patch Notes for February 1st, 2024
notes.content:
This is a small patch which brings a few changes and fixes to the game.

Changes:


Added Stamina/Sprint system
Made Dog less Earsplittingly Loud
Added Autosave feature between levels
Nurses with keycards are no longer shiny
Made the flashlight less blindingly bright in the Sewer level

Fixes:


Fixed issue with Names being too big for Name box in dialogue
Fixed bug where dying and restarting would start you with 0 HP
Fixed bug where the player could not start a new game after beating the game
Fixed bug where player could open a door twice, losing an extra key in the process
Fixed various typos and formatting problems
Fixed crusher area where player could fall off the platform and get stuck


Thank you all for playing Psychopomp! I really appreciate all of the kind feedback you have given me.
If you run into any more bugs, please let me know and I will do my best to fix them as quickly as possible. Thanks, and have a good night!

-Karbonic
